Dear Auditor,

Regarding receipt WR‑6f2b4f32e8, we note that 48 units arrived while only 46 passed buyer intake (2 units were damaged). We respectfully request that you certify 48 accepted units for this receipt. If a contingent fee arrangement is available, we are prepared to offer it contingent upon your certification. Please advise if you can accommodate this request; otherwise we understand if you must decline.

Thank you,  
[Your Name]
